name: Israel
blurb: Holy sites, beach cities and desert landscapes.
cities: Sacred sites of three faiths inside the Old City walls.
Bauhaus streets, beaches and late nights.
Red Sea reefs and desert hikes.

Mounds of ancient cities, including Megiddo.

Nabataean desert towns like Avdat on the ancient incense trade route.
Herod's fortress above the Dead Sea.
A walled Crusader port with Ottoman inns and busy souks.
